debrief db-021
1) the actor l-o-g-g-e-d into t-h-r-e-e l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s w-i-t-h s-t-o-l-e-n c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n c-o-o-k-i-e s in t-h-e b-r-o-w-s-e-r c-a-c-h-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the actor r-u-n a s-c-r-i-p-t that d-r-a-i-n-e-d g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s to a p-r-e-p-a-y-d c-o-d-e p-u-r-s-e-o-n, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n l-o-g f-i-l-e in /tmp, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-l-o-c-i-t-y t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d a-l-e-r-t
3) the actor p-l-a-c-e-d small o-r-d-e-r-s of i-t-e-m-s m-a-r-k-e-d for k-n-o-c-k-o-f-f r-e-t-u-r-n-s, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g r-e-f-u-n-d r-e-q-u-e-s-t j-s-o-n f-i-l-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-t-u-r-n r-e-a-s-o-n a-u-d-i-t
4) the actor r-o-t-a-t-e-d i-p a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-s via a p-r-o-x-y p-o-o-l, l-e-a-v-i-n-g r-o-u-t-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a in the c-a-r-t b-a-s-k-e-t t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-o g-r-a-b b-l-o-c-k f-i-l-t-e-r
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-v-i-e-w p-a-g-e a-f-t-e-r w-i-t-h-d-r-a-w-a-l-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-t-a-t-i-c h-t-m-l s-n-a-p-s-h-o-t in the w-o-r-k-i-n-g d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-v-i-c-e-f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w
